subject: E-1211: database locked on Windows
body:
Hello help desk team. We run SyncVault 4.2.2 on Windows 11
23H2. Whenever I open the app since the weekend, the app
shows "E-1211: local database is locked".

A file-sync tool continuously mirrors the directory that holds
the app data. Whenever the sync tool uploads something the
lock displays up.

Before writing in I tried waiting a day; same error
afterwards.

Thanks, Sofia Rossi (Ferro & Sons)
